other_conditions: The primary breadwinner must be an earning member of the family.
The death of the breadwinner must be caused by an accident.
The applicant must be a legal heir of the deceased primary breadwinner.
The family must be engaged in any of the 44 notified occupational categories.
The application must be submitted within 6 months of the death.
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹20,000 (or ₹5,000‑₹15,000 depending on injury) to the legal heirs of a BPL household when the primary breadwinner dies in an accident.
